completed_tasks.title: OS-Agnostic Governance and Dispatch
completed_tasks.objective: Make Score2GP governance, dispatch and validation OS-agnostic: resolve the worker role from the authenticated GitHub login cross-checked against the workspace path, resolve Python and tools portably, and remove WSL, /home and .venv/bin mandates from live governance, without altering product recognition semantics.
acceptance: Live governance documents in allowed_paths contain no WSL execution gate, /home/<user> or /mnt/c path rule, or .venv/bin-only instruction; the workspace is defined relative to a workspace root with worktrees/auto, worktrees/gov and worktrees/codex. The agent entrypoints AGENTS.md and AGENT-RULES.md use portable python commands (never python3-only) and state that the role comes from the authenticated GitHub login, not the host OS identity; AGENT-RULES.md keeps the product automation mentions the governance audit requires.

The worker role is resolved from the authenticated GitHub login using ORCHESTRATION_STATE.json roles and cross-checked against the workspace path; tticomgov-code routes to the governance/reviewer path; a mismatch, unknown login or gh failure fails closed; OS usernames and environment variables never select a role. Tests cover every case, including the negative ones.
Python and virtualenv resolution is portable (.venv/Scripts/python.exe or .venv/bin/python) and fails cleanly when neither exists.
scripts/verify_identity.py is the only identity gate, is Python-only, and passes on native Windows and Linux.
tests/conftest.py starts on native Windows while keeping its noexec protection on Linux.

The workflow skills source is tticom/agentops-claude-skills: SKILLS_LOCK.md pins a commit on its main, score2gp_control_plane.py resolves its skills/<name> layout and pin checkouts, the dispatch and bootstrap --skills-repo defaults resolve to the agentops-claude-skills checkout that is a sibling of the running score2gp-agentops checkout (worktrees/<auto|gov|codex>/agentops-claude-skills), with tests for all three layouts, and live governance documents no longer name agy-skills as the skills source. Pin and missing-skill gates still fail closed, with tests.
The governance audit and the targeted tests pass on native Windows and in Linux CI; the full python -m pytest suite passes in Linux CI. A green full suite on native Windows is WIN-02's acceptance.
Zero changes to product recognition, parsing, ScoreIR, or GP compilation code.
